subject: Data description entry
notes: Format 1's level-number domain, enforced as the intersection of two independent screens rather than a fourth copy of a set: the 13.18.33.3 section screen bounds the VALUE, and the 13.18.33.4 GR2b/GR2c format arms remove 66 and 88 from any entry that is not written in the renames or condition-name format.
